title: Ball integrals of test-function differences along graph blow-ups tend to zero
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ. Let ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} be linear isometries. Let f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ be continuous and differentiable at v ∈ ℝⁿ, with T := Df(v) (Mathlib fderiv ℝ f v). Let ψ : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ be continuous with compact support, and let R ∈ ℝ. Then, with Lⁿ the Lebesgue measure (volume) on ℝⁿ, U(r) := ∫_{closedBall(0,R)} |ψ(ιw + ι'(r⁻¹(f(v + rw) − f(v)))) − ψ(ιw + ι'(T w))| dLⁿ(w) → 0 as r ↓ 0 (along 𝓝[>] 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (v : Euclid n) (ψ : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ), Continuous f → DifferentiableAt ℝ f v → Continuous ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ R : ℝ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ w in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) R, |ψ (ι w + ι' (r⁻¹ • (f (v + r • w) - f v))) - ψ (ι w + ι' (fderiv ℝ f v w))|) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
